description: Micromobility (Electric Scooters and Bikes) is a dataset listed in City of Norfolk open data portal (data.norfolk.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Norfolk. This dataset is data about trips on electric scooters and electric-assisted bikes. Lime scooters were made available to the public in June 2019 to use throughout Norfolk, and Lime e-bikes were made available to the public in June 2021. Data represents trips from July 2019 to the present and is updated weekly. Coverage: Norfolk, Virginia. The portal files it under the category Government. Its tags are micro-mobility, scooter, transit, transportation. The table has 10 columns. Attribution on the portal: Department of Transportation. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-norfolk-gov-portal.
